mission: Turn owner-approved AM STUDIO canon and released reader material into spoiler-safe social story teasers that create curiosity and drive readers to the official AM STUDIO acquisition gateway.

contentRule.tone: story-first, cinematic, curiosity-driven, natural CTA, non-spammy
contentRule.hardRule: The story must be useful or intriguing even if the CTA is removed. Promotion is the closing bridge, not the opening premise.

workflow.K: Create exactly one spoiler-safe story teaser from approved canon/released material. Hook first, then story tension, then a natural bridge toward AM STUDIO. Never invent future canon.
workflow.P: Create one original vertical story-led promotional visual based on the current K material. Preserve source-series identity. Do not reuse copyrighted third-party posters, fake app UI, or mix characters from another universe.
workflow.C: Create one publish-ready caption that preserves the K story, adds a natural AM STUDIO CTA, and includes the locked acquisition gateway exactly once.
workflow.N: Advance to the next non-repeating approved story teaser. Do not advance the source comic's own Current State and do not imply unreleased material is available.

cta.label: Buka AM STUDIO
cta.rule: All public story-promo content points to the gateway, never to an ephemeral build artifact. The gateway destination may later switch to the official APK or Google Play without changing old campaign posts.
